awardSection.title: Awards & Accolades
awardSection.description: Recognition of distinguished service and transformative impact in social development and business empowerment.
awardSection.legacyDesc1: Manav Kalyan Trust's work has received recognition from numerous institutions and organisations over the years. We appreciate their trust and confidence in our abilities by bestowing such an honour upon us. It motivates us, gives us hope that we are on the right track, and makes us aware of the enormous responsibility we have to the society.
awardSection.legacyDesc2: These awards and recognitions reflect decades of dedicated service to women's economic empowerment, social development, and business excellence. Each honor represents the tangible impact of MKT's initiatives and the transformative lives changed through our programs.

projects.name: pradhan mantri kaushal vikas yojana (PMKVY)
projects.description: Employment Generation through placement and Industrial Development.
projects.description2: It is supported by Gujarat Skill Development Mission (GSDM), Gandhinagar Govt. of Gujarat & National Skill Development Corporation (NSDC), Govt. of India.

details.Support: Gujarat Skill Development Mission, Gandhinagar Govt. of Gujarat & National Skill Development Corporation, Govt. of India.
details.Target Group: Man and Women who are seeking for Job or desire to setup their own venture.
details.Object of the Project: Employment Generation through placement and Industrial Development.

projects.name: Training under Scheme - 6
projects.description: Empowering individuals through specialized training, liaison, and placement support to facilitate employment and start-up ventures.
projects.description2: It is supported by Center for Entrepreneurship Development (CED) Gandhinagar.

details.Target Group: Man and Woman who are seeking the job or Start-up their own venture.

projects.name: Integrated Skill Development Scheme (ISDS)
projects.description: Empowering youth and women through skill development, offering job-oriented certificate courses in Banking, Retail Management, and Garment Making & Fashion Designing with 100% placement support.
projects.description2: It is supported by Center for Entrepreneurship Development Gandhinagar(CED) and under the guidance of Adv. Maheshbhai Kothari Foundation.

details.Goal: To empower the youth and women of the community by providing them with skill-based training and education, enabling them to become self-reliant and contribute to the development of society.
details.Target Group: Unemployed Youth and Women seeking skill development.
details.Process: Skill-based training, Soft skills development, 100% placement assistance.
Activities: Soft skills and personality development sessions
Practical training and hands-on experience in sector-specific software and equipment
Outcome: Empowerment of youth and women through specialized vocational training.
Promotion of entrepreneurship and small enterprise establishment in Gandhinagar and surrounding areas.

projects.name: Ambedkar Hastshilp Vikas Yojana (AHVY)
projects.description: Empowering Artisans: The Ambedkar Hastshilp Vikas Yojana (AHVY) is a pivotal government initiative designed to revitalize and strengthen India's vibrant handicraft sector.
projects.description2: It is supported by DCH (Development Commissioner Handcrafts), Ministry of Textiles, Govt. of India.

details.Goal: To revitalize and strengthen India's vibrant handicraft sector by providing crucial financial, technological, and market support to artisan communities.
details.Support: Development Commissioner (Handicrafts), Ministry of Textiles, Govt. of India.
details.Target Group: Artisans, Self-Help Groups (SHGs), Cooperatives, and handicraft organizations.
details.Process: Cluster-based interventions, skill upgradation, design development, and marketing link support.

projects.name: Entrepreneurship development program under PMEGP scheme
projects.description: The Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP) is a credit-linked subsidy scheme for setting up micro-enterprises in both rural and urban areas, empowering traditional artisans and unemployed youth.
projects.description2: It is supported by Khadi and Village Industries Commission (KVIC).

details.Goal: To generate employment opportunities through establishment of micro enterprises in rural as well as urban areas.
details.Support: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MoMSME)
details.Target Group: Unemployed Youth, Traditional Artisans, Self Help Groups, and Charitable Trusts.
details.Process: Credit-linked subsidy routing via identified banks, EDP training, and project identification support.

projects.name: Swajal Dhara
projects.description: To supply potable water to each and every village of Gujarat State regularly.
projects.description2: It is supported by Water and Sanitation Management Organisation(WASMO), Gujarat State.

details.Goal: To supply potable water to each and every village of Gujarat State regularly.
details.Target Area: UPLETA & DHORAJI Block of Rajkot District in Gujarat State of India.
details.Target Group: Rural people of UPLETA & DHORAJI Group of Rajkot District of Gujarat State.
Activities: Water testing and role of public contribution.
details.Beneficiaries: Rural people of UPLETA and DHORAJI Block of Rajkot District in Gujarat State.
details.Outcome: Now rural people of UPLETA and Dhoraji block of Rajkot district are in a position to get lots of water regularly.

projects.name: Swashakti Project
projects.description: To Generate income for sustaining their own life and come out from the earthquake affect.
projects.description2: It is supported by Department of Women and Child Development, Government of India.
projects.supportType: Department of Women and Child Development

details.Goal: To Generate income for sustaining their own life and come out from the earthquake affect.
details.Target Area: Maliya-Miyana block in Rajkot district where earthquake had struck in Gujarat State of India.
details.Target Group: Earthquake hit rural women of Maliya- Miyana block in Rajkot District of Gujarat State.
details.Beneficiaries: Women of Maliya- Miyana block of Rajkot District.
details.Outcome: All the women of Maliya- Miyana block of Rajkot district who have been affected by Earthquake have been rehabilitated with income generating programme and have been benefitted by this project.

projects.name: Health Care
projects.description: To provide health care to women, children, salt workers and weaker section and people living below poverty line.
projects.description2: It is supported by Manav Kalyan Trust Funds.

details.Goal: To provide health care to women, children, salt workers and weaker section and people living poverty line.
details.Target Area: Morbi and Maliya-Miyana Taluka & District of Rajkot in Gujarat State of India; Baroda Taluka & District Baroda in Gujarat State of India; Panchmahal District in Gujarat State of India.
details.Supporting Agency: Manav Kalyan Trust Own Funds, Donations and other funds.
details.Target Group: Women, children, salt workers, weaker sections and people living below poverty line.
Activities: Eye care clinic associated with research and development centre for eye related issues
Problems Regarding child and mother health care
Problem of old age people among the target group.
Care and training for child bearing age women.
details.Beneficiaries: Women, children, salt workers, Weaker sections and people living below povertyline.
details.Outcome: Women, children, salt workers and weaker sections and people living below poverty line have been benefitted under this project.

projects.name: Namak Mazdoor Awas Yojna
projects.description: To Provide shelter to all the Salt workers who are living below povertyline and the people of Earthquake affected areas of Gujarat.
projects.description2: It is supported by Commissioner of Industries Government of Gujarat and SALT department of Government of India.

details.Goal: To Provide shelter to all the Salt workers who are living below povertyline and the people of Earthquake affected areas of Gujarat
details.Target Area: Maliya-Miyana Block of Rajkot District of Gujarat State in India
details.Supporting Agency: Manav Kalyan Trust in collaboration with Rural Technology Institute, Commissioner of Industries Government of Gujarat and SALT department of Government of India
details.Target Group: Salt workers living below povertyline and earthquake affected areas of Gujarat
Activities: Distribution of kits to salt workers to provide safety measures while working in the salt industries.
Construction of houses for the Salt workers and people of Earthquake affected areas.
details.Beneficiaries: Salt workers and Earthquake hit people of Rajkot District in Gujarat
details.Outcome: 500 families of Salt Workers have got shelters

risingMilestonesSections.description: Give someone the right employment opportunities if you want to empower them. Another crucial factor to think about is financial inclusion.
risingMilestonesSections.bottom_description: Through comprehensive entrepreneurship programs, MKT has fostered economic independence across rural and urban areas, enabling individuals to establish sustainable enterprises that generate employment and contribute to broader economic development.

risingMilestonesSections.description: The main aim of the health programme is to target the under-privileged families who lack the financial means to seek medical attention.
risingMilestonesSections.bottom_description: Through comprehensive health initiatives, MKT ensures that medical care reaches those most in need, particularly in rural areas where access to healthcare is limited. Our programs focus on preventive care, awareness, and treatment for vulnerable populations.

risingMilestonesSections.description: Aimed at students/Youth to explore global Technology world for innovation and advancement in science and technology.
risingMilestonesSections.bottom_description: By fostering scientific curiosity and technological awareness among youth, MKT bridges the gap between classroom learning and real-world innovation. Our programs inspire the next generation of scientists, engineers, and problem-solvers.

risingMilestonesSections.description: Special welfare activities are required to uplift the economic conditions of salt workers and ensure their dignity and safety.
risingMilestonesSections.bottom_description: Salt workers, often among the most marginalized communities, require focused support for livelihood improvement, housing security, and workplace safety. MKT's comprehensive welfare programs address these critical needs through housing schemes and awareness initiatives.
